description:
Build the type hierarchy from repository declarations through one fallible constructor with one error policy.

## Background

Three production sites build a `HierarchyConfig` from `LabelNamespaces` with three policies: `config_manager.rs:305-309` wraps the error in an invalid-argument error, `commands/validate.rs:1039` propagates the raw `ConfigError`, and `repository_state/default_rules.rs:518-526` silently falls back to `HierarchyConfig::empty()`. A level-0 type is therefore accepted by one command family and rejected by another.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `HierarchyConfig::from_declarations(&LabelNamespaces)` in `domain/type_taxonomy.rs` returns `Result<HierarchyConfig, ConfigError>` and is the one production constructor from declarations.
- [hard] REQ-02: The three production sites build through it and keep their current error policies, so no caller changes.
- [hard] REQ-03: Taxonomy unit tests show that an invalid hierarchy yields the constructor's `ConfigError`.
title: HierarchyConfig has one fallible constructor from declarations
